display.purpose: One hero word per page, rendered as a stroked-outline transparent-fill glyph with a hard layered drop shadow. Never used for section titles or running text.

headline.purpose: Section titles, almost always paired with the highlighter-gradient variant.

body.purpose: Default reading copy across About, Resume, and Work descriptions.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, tech-tag pills — always bold with tracked-out letter-spacing.

shadows.name: pop-sm
shadows.purpose: Hard, zero-blur hover shadow on Button, paired with a small up-left translate.

shadows.name: pop-lg
shadows.purpose: Hard, zero-blur hover shadow on clickable Card, scaled up from pop-sm.

motion.name: pop-transition
motion.purpose: Shared hover-pop transition for Button and Card.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action pill: Deep Eggplant fill, pink-tinted text, hard offset-shadow pop on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 30px; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 300ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 300ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #330036; color: color-mix(in oklch, #fe019a 70%, #ffffff); border: solid 2px #330036; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { transform: translate(-0.25rem, -0.25rem); box-shadow: .25rem .25rem 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, #fe019a 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Inverted-fill pill for lower-emphasis actions alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 30px; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 300ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 300ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #f2f2f2; color: #330036; border: solid 2px #330036; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { transform: translate(-0.25rem, -0.25rem); box-shadow: .25rem .25rem 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, #fe019a 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Disabled Tag Pill
components.description: Non-interactive tech-tag chip, reusing the disabled button variant — no hover physics, rendered as a span.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 30px; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1; background-color: #f2f2f2; color: #858585; border: solid 2px #858585; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base surface: rounded-3xl, thick pink outline, flat at rest, hard offset-shadow pop when clickable.

components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #f2f2f2; border: 2px solid #fe019a; border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; transition: transform 300ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 300ms ease-in-out; } .ds-card--clickable { cursor: pointer; } .ds-card--clickable:hover, .ds-card--clickable:focus-visible { transform: translate(-0.5rem, -0.5rem); box-shadow: .5rem .5rem 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, #fe019a 40%, transparent); } .ds-card__title { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #330036; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card__body { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; color: #330036; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Section Headline (Highlighter)
components.description: Section-title treatment: bold heading text struck through with a two-tone highlighter-marker gradient band.
components.css: .ds-headline { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1; margin: 0; color: #330036; } .ds-headline__highlight { background-image: linear-gradient(#edff00, #c9ff00); -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; background-position: 0 88%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 100% 32%; padding-inline: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky header with a thick bottom border and a two-tone stroked/filled wordmark.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; background-color: #f2f2f2; border-bottom: .15rem solid #330036; padding: 1rem 2rem; position: sticky; top: 0; font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav__wordmark { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.05rem #330036; } .ds-nav__wordmark-accent { -webkit-text-fill-color: #fe019a; text-shadow: 0.2rem 0.2rem 0 color-mix(in oklch, #330036 12%, transparent); } .ds-nav__wordmark-ink { -webkit-text-fill-color: #330036; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-nav__links a { color: #330036; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Contact Tile
components.description: Signature composite: a clickable Card holding a circular accent-tinted icon badge, a label, and a handle.
components.css: .ds-contact-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; background-color: color-mix(in oklch, #fe019a 30%, transparent); border: 2px solid #fe019a; border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 300ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 300ms ease-in-out; } .ds-contact-tile:hover, .ds-contact-tile:focus-visible { transform: translate(-0.5rem, -0.5rem); box-shadow: .5rem .5rem 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, #fe019a 40%, transparent); } .ds-contact-tile__badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: 1.5rem; background-color: color-mix(in oklch, #fe019a 20%, transparent); color: #330036; font-size: 1.25rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-contact-tile__text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-contact-tile__label { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #330036; } .ds-contact-tile__handle { font-family: var(--font-Fredoka), sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #858585; }

narrative.overview:
TaraDunmore.com looks like a sheet of stickers laid out by hand, not a template filled in: thick cartoon-outline borders, pill-shaped buttons, and section titles struck through with a highlighter-marker gradient. Hero elements sit slightly off-grid — the headshot rotated a few degrees inside two independently-tilted outline rings, the giant stroked "hi!" cocked at -4deg — the deliberate imperfection of something placed by hand rather than centered by a grid system. Nothing here is trying to look safe or corporate; it's a portfolio that argues its own case by being unmistakably made, not generated.

The palette does the same job in color: a stark, near-black-purple ink (Deep Eggplant) against a soft paper neutral, with exactly two accents — Electric Pink and Acid Lime — that never dilute into a third. Depth stays flat at rest; it only appears as a hard, no-blur, colored offset shadow the instant something becomes interactive, reinforcing the sticker-peel physicality rather than simulating real-world light.

This system explicitly rejects soft, muted, corporate-minimalist portfolio conventions — no gradients-as-glow, no frosted panels, no safe SaaS-dashboard palette. The bet is that "design roots, developer instincts" reads more convincingly through unapologetic, tactile craft than through restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Thick 2px ink/accent outlines paired with generous rounded corners (pills, rounded-3xl)
Flat at rest, hard offset "pop" shadow + translate on hover/click — never a soft blur
Exactly two accents (Electric Pink, Acid Lime) against one ink neutral (Deep Eggplant)
Deliberate off-grid rotation on hero elements (headshot rings, display headline)
One display font reserved for a single hero word; Fredoka carries everything else

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric Pink and Acid Lime are the only saturated accents in the system. A new UI need reaches for Deep Eggplant, Paper White, or Warm Shade before it reaches for a third hue.

rules.name: The One-Word Display Rule
rules.body: The display face and its outline/shadow treatment appear on exactly one hero word per page. It is a signature moment, not a heading style.

rules.name: The Pop-on-Touch Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. A hard, accent-tinted, zero-blur offset shadow plus a small translate is the only depth cue, and it appears only in response to hover or interaction.

dos: Do pair every clickable surface — button or card — with the same hard offset-shadow-plus-translate pop on hover; it's one interaction physic, not a per-component choice.
Do keep Electric Pink and Acid Lime as the system's only two accents (The Two-Accent Rule); reach for Deep Eggplant, Paper White, or Warm Shade before introducing a third hue.
Do reserve the Cherry Bomb One display treatment for a single hero word per page (The One-Word Display Rule); Fredoka carries every other typographic role.
Do treat lg (1024px) as the layout's real pivot — build mobile-first, then restructure at lg:, matching the rest of the codebase.
Do use the highlighter-gradient headline variant for section titles specifically; it's a title treatment, not a general emphasis style for body copy.
donts: Don't reintroduce soft, muted, corporate-minimalist styling — no soft-blurred shadows, no desaturated "safe" palette, no glassmorphism/glow. This system's whole thesis is that it doesn't look like a template.

Don't treat --accent-bg, --accent-border, --code-bg, --social-bg, --black, --text-h, or --shadow as live tokens — they're declared in globals.css but not referenced by any component; verify a token is actually consumed before reusing it.

Don't rely on the font-display class (nav wordmark) or shadow-small / shadow-medium classes (blog cover image) as real styles — none of the three are defined anywhere in the Tailwind config or CSS; they currently resolve to nothing.

Don't treat the <Footer> rendered in app/layout.tsx as part of this system — it's unstyled Next.js-starter boilerplate (bg-accent-1, border-accent-2, text-success, "Read Documentation" / "View on GitHub") predating the current identity and uses none of its tokens.

Don't assume /blog or /work/[slug] already carry this system — both still run bare Tailwind defaults (plain container mx-auto px-5, no color bands, no Button/Card treatment) and haven't been brought into the Sticker Sheet identity yet.
